verdict.line: You lose extended poke exchanges while Gnar's E is up, and you win every fight you force the instant his E (Hop) goes on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Gnar's mini form survives entirely on kiting you with Q (Boomerang Throw, 1100 range) and resetting space with E (Hop, 475 range), but both tools sit on 16-10s and 22-12s cooldowns — longer than your entire kit. The structural fact of this lane is that your Q, W, and E are all faster than his gap tools, so whoever controls when the gap closes controls the lane. That's the real reason Darius sits at 52.6% over 266 games with the solo-kill edge here: it's an even lane that tips hard in your favor the moment you stop respecting his kiting window and start punishing his cooldown window.

tell.watch: Gnar's Rage bar and E CD

theirWindow.what: He can poke freely with Q (Boomerang Throw) and bail the instant you step up, with W (Hyper) padding his trade damage while he disengages. Don't walk into Q range without a minion screen — you're just feeding him free pokes and Rage toward transform.

yourWindow.what: Close the gap immediately: land E (Apprehend, 535 range) to hook him in, then W (Crippling Strike) to slow so he can't walk-and-auto away again, and chain Q (Decimate) for Hemorrhage stacks and the heal off the blade. This is literally OP.GG's own read on the matchup, and the cooldown math backs it up.

powerCurve.note: Gnar pokes safely with Boomerang Throw
Q+E kite keeps you off him
R online, E hook snowballs kills
Mega Gnar access evens trades back
Stacked Hemorrhage makes R a true-damage execute

start.why: 51% win rate over 202 games and the top pick at 62.2%. The sustain lets you eat Boomerang Throw pokes without losing the lane while you wait for his E to go down.

boots.why: 48.9% win rate, 73.3% pick rate. Flattens the auto-attack and Q chip damage Gnar leans on in mini form before you ever get to close distance.

core.why: The active's movement burst is your answer to his kiting — it turns your E-window all-ins into guaranteed stick instead of a 50/50 chase.
Builds move speed just from walking up to him in lane, closing the gap passively between cooldown-timed engages.
Sustains you through skirmishes and the Mega Gnar stun combo long enough to land the Hemorrhage-stacked Guillotine.

situational.when: mega gnar's wallop stun into his r is threatening to burst you down in a single combo
you want mobility online earlier than youmuu's to start closing gaps before level 6
the enemy team adds magic damage on top of gnar's physical poke

runes.keystoneWhy: 42.3% win rate, 36.7% pick. Rewards ability usage with a burst of move speed — exactly the tool you need the instant his E goes down and you need to close the distance before he resets.

summoners.why: 53.6% win rate, the highest of the three measured combos. Ignite pairs with your Hemorrhage stacking and true-damage Guillotine to secure kills the moment you force a fight in your window, rather than relying on Ghost to simply keep pace with his Hop.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown, not the wave
playing.detail: Hop sits at 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s. The second it's down, that's your signal to walk up — not minion state, not his HP.

playing.title: Hold Apprehend for lockdown, not pokes
playing.detail: E's 535 range can't reach his 1100-range Q pokes. Save it for when he's forced into melee range or overextends on CS.

playing.title: Stack Hemorrhage before you Guillotine
playing.detail: R's true damage scales with his bleed stacks — land Q and an auto or two before committing R for the real number.

playing.title: Respect the Rage bar from level 6 on
playing.detail: Once his passive nears max and R (GNAR!, cd 90/60/30/0/0s) is up, he can transform mid-fight into a form with a stun (W Wallop) and a wall-stun ultimate. Don't fight him against a wall near max Rage.

playing.title: Freeze early to force his approach
playing.detail: Between levels 1-5, holding the wave near your tower makes mini-form Gnar walk up for CS, handing you free Apprehend windows instead of chasing him.

playing.title: Buy Youmuu's active for your all-in, not for split push
playing.detail: Pop the haste the moment his E is down so your engage actually lands before he can Hop away again.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.20.1). The cooldown timings, ability behavior, and tactical reasoning — when to engage, what to hold E for, how the Rage/transform threat plays out — are my own read on the matchup, not measured stats.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being kited by Gnar by managing your distance well. Close in on him when (E) is on cooldown to fight him.
